title: Provenance tip cache contract (L20)
description: Invariants for the L1 TTL'd warm cache layer in MagmaProvenanceAdapter. See ADR-023.

tiers.name: session_hot_dict
tiers.authoritative_for: facts written via record_provenance in this process

invariants.name: tracker_authoritative
invariants.description: L1 is a read-through view. Tracker is source of truth for non-L0 facts.
must: TTL expiry forces fresh tracker read
L1 hit MUST NOT outlive its insertion timestamp + TTL_SECONDS
tracker delete + 5s wait + re-lookup MUST return None (not stale hit)

invariants.name: L0_supersedes_L1
invariants.description: Facts in self._records (session-local) are authoritative over any L1 cached entry with the same fact_id.
must: get_provenance checks L0 before L1
record_provenance invalidates the L1 entry for that fact_id

invariants.name: ttl_bound
invariants.description: Cache entries expire after _TTL_SECONDS (default 5.0) and trigger fresh tracker read.
must: entry timestamp captured at insertion
lookup compares now - entry_ts against TTL_SECONDS
TTL_SECONDS configurable via constructor (default 5.0)

invariants.name: lru_bounded
invariants.description: Cache size MUST NOT exceed _CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES (default 1000). Oldest-by-access eviction.
must: size capped via collections.OrderedDict or functools.lru_cache or equivalent
size limit configurable via constructor (default 1000)
eviction is LRU (oldest by access, not by insertion)

invariants.name: no_write_amplification
invariants.description: Cache reads do NOT modify tracker state. Cache miss triggers exactly one tracker read.
must: no calls back into record_provenance from get_provenance path
no double-fetch on cache miss
no eager tracker reads outside the explicit prewarm path

invariants.name: boot_preload_optional
invariants.description: Constructor option prewarm_on_init=True pulls last K tips from tracker. Default False so Container instantiation does no implicit DB read.
must: prewarm_on_init defaults to False
prewarm uses bounded last-K query, not full tracker scan
prewarm failure logs WARNING and continues with empty L1 (does not crash __init__)

invariants.name: invalidation_hook
invariants.description: MagmaProvenanceAdapter.invalidate_cache(fact_id=None) MUST be available: None flushes all, specific id flushes that entry.
must: invalidate_cache() (no arg or fact_id=None) clears L1 entirely
invalidate_cache(fact_id='X') removes that single entry
method exists on the adapter -- not buried in a private _TipCache instance
